name: Who On Earth
description: Trenton hard rock band built around big hooks and groove, drawing on Sabbath, Maiden, Alice In Chains and Tool. Their records have been produced by Mike Orlando of Adrenaline Mob.
activity: Released the Smoke & Mirrors EP in 2025 and the album It Takes The Village in 2026. Toured with Fozzy in spring 2026 and put out a 'Good Man Down' video in July 2026.

name: Doc Rotten
description: Street punk band formed in Trenton in 2017. Mill Hill Basement has long been their home stage, and Pete of the Bouncing Souls produced one of their records.
activity: Self-titled second LP came out in January 2024 and was reissued by Creep Records. It was a Bandcamp New & Notable pick in April 2025.

name: The Successful Failures
description: Long-running Trenton-area band led by songwriter Mick Chorba. They mix Americana, power pop and rock with a touch of bluegrass.
activity: Released the Sun Studio Session EP and several singles in 2025. Their site announced a November 21, 2026 rock show.

name: Grace Little Band (The Amazin' Grace Little Band)
description: Eight-piece band led by Trenton vocalist Grace Little, an Apollo amateur-night winner and Broadway touring veteran. They cover soul, jazz, funk, reggae, Latin and Top 40.
activity: Played the Princeton Shopping Center summer concert series on June 26, 2026. Grace Little also played the Kennedy Center Millennium Stage in July 2026.

name: Out of the Red
genre: Cover band (classic rock, punk, alternative, Top 40, funk, country)
description: Trenton cover band that plays long bar and party sets mixing classic rock, punk, alternative, Top 40, funk and modern country. They play across Mercer, Burlington and Bucks counties.
activity: Played the Olde Nottingham Tavern in Hamilton Square on July 11, 2026. They have had an active booking profile since 2024.

name: Dragonfly
description: Princeton five-piece party-rock and dance band that plays decades of hits, from Motown and disco to '90s alternative and current pop. They can also scale down to a duo or trio.
activity: Played the Princeton Shopping Center Courtyard series on July 24, 2026 and an Ewing car show on October 10, 2026. Dates are booked into November 2026 and 2027.

name: The Beagles with Joy
description: Princeton band whose album Listen for a Moment came out with three singles: 'Anew', the title track and 'Mountain Walk'.
activity: Their title track was a Makin Waves Song of the Week in August 2026. They held a hometown release show at Hinds Plaza in Princeton on August 30, 2026.

name: A Parallax View
description: Experimental rock band listed in Princeton, making slow, soothing, textured guitar music. They sell handmade CDs and have a live recording from New York City.
activity: Posted a demo in July 2026 and a new release, Realities and Ideals, on October 23, 2026.

name: Rat Sauce
description: Bordentown punk band with a self-deprecating sense of humor, playing short, scrappy songs.
activity: Released the Detention Deficit album in September 2025 and the single 'My AI' in July 2026.

name: Grand Sedan
description: Groove-heavy indie rock project formed in Highland Park in summer 2024. They play regularly at Pino's and at local porch and arts festivals.
activity: 2026 shows include Highland Park Porchfest (May), Arts in the Park (September) and Metuchen PorchFest (October). Upcoming: Pino's on November 6, 2026 and Hailey's in Metuchen on December 12, 2026.

name: Roadside Graves
description: Metuchen band going for close to two decades, with a ragged Americana-folk-indie sound often compared to the Band and the Jayhawks. They have played Red Rocks, and their songs have turned up in film and TV.
activity: Headlined Highland Park's free Parkstock concert at Donaldson Park on July 16, 2026. They also played their annual hometown pizza show in Metuchen in April 2025.

name: Ogbert the Nerd
description: New Brunswick emo band formed in 2018 out of the basement scene. They have put out two full-lengths, I Don't Hate You and What You Want.
activity: Released a Christmas single in 2025 and the single 'Stapler' in 2026.

name: Tokyo Rose
description: New Brunswick emo-pop-punk band from the early-2000s scene that reunited and is releasing music again. Fred Mascherino co-produced their comeback record.
activity: Released 'Something Sweeter' in January 2026 and the Never Say Die EP in 2026. They have a November 2026 tour with Punchline, including Asbury Park's Wonder Bar on November 20.

name: Glazer
description: New Brunswick basement-scene band with a long run of DIY releases, splits and live recordings. They have donated proceeds to Elijah's Promise soup kitchen in New Brunswick.
activity: A Glazer release was a Bandcamp New & Notable pick on August 5, 2026.

name: Public Access
description: New Brunswick indie band with a steady run of EPs and singles, including Escape The Fantasy and no brim.
activity: Released no brim in September 2024. Played Pino's in Highland Park on May 19, 2025.

name: Hanging Coats
description: Six-piece Rutgers student band that grew out of late-night jams in spring 2025. They blend shoegaze, indie rock and R&B.
activity: Played the New Jersey Film Festival audio-visual concert at Rutgers on October 2, 2026, and is working on a debut EP.

name: Lawns
description: Rutgers student band from the New Brunswick house-show scene. They mix rock with jazz, folk and avant-garde ideas.
activity: Had three singles out and a self-titled debut album planned for August 2026. Played the NJ Film Festival concert at Rutgers on October 2, 2026.

name: Heron House
description: Band of longtime area musicians, all Rutgers grads or staff, playing R.E.M.'s 1981-87 catalog. They are named after a song on Document.
activity: Played Rutgers Day in April 2025. Shared a porch bill with Grand Sedan at Highland Park Porchfest on May 17, 2026.

name: The Bouncing Souls
description: Punk band born in New Brunswick in the late '80s and still one of the city's best-known exports. Their anthems grew out of the local basement and bar scene.
activity: On the 2026 North to Shore Festival lineup in Asbury Park, June 2026. Note: formed in New Brunswick, now tours nationally.

name: Thursday
description: Influential post-hardcore band formed in New Brunswick in 1997. They came out of the same basement scene and are still headlining clubs and festivals.
activity: Toured in 2026, with spring club dates such as Wonder Ballroom in Portland on April 15, 2026 plus fall festival slots. Note: formed in New Brunswick, now tours nationally.
